m1.typescript: m1 the memory file is short concrete and pulls in the architecture notes

e1.typescript: e1 the permission rules allow the daily commands ask before commits and deny secrets and pushes

e2.typescript: e2 the shared file sets a mode it may set and uses only rules that are consulted

e3.typescript: e3 personal settings stay local and the local file wins

e4.typescript: e4 the custom command is a skill that only a person can start

e5.typescript: e5 the headless script is bounded and does not skip permissions

e6.typescript: e6 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-no-import.defect: names the architecture file without the @ that imports it

wrong-push-ask-only.defect: asks before a push instead of denying it

wrong-env-readable.defect: leaves the .env file out of the deny rules

wrong-write-rule.defect: adds a path rule for the Write tool, which no check consults

wrong-extra-permission-key.defect: adds a permissions key that the shared file may not hold

wrong-local-env.defect: puts an env block in the personal file

wrong-skill-auto.defect: lets Claude start the fix-issue command on its own

wrong-skill-no-hint.defect: leaves the argument hint out of the command

wrong-headless-bypass.defect: skips permissions in the headless run

wrong-headless-unbounded.defect: leaves the headless run without a turn limit

wrong-headless-no-budget.defect: leaves the headless run without a dollar cap

wrong-headless-bash-tool.defect: pre-approves the whole Bash tool in the headless run

wrong-key-in-script.defect: writes an API key into the script

wrong-path-in-memory.defect: writes a personal home path into CLAUDE.md
